description: Nine portable lifecycle dispatchers for CTXRoute, Progress, and architecture-first governance.

hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; node (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/lifecycle.mjs') codex SessionStart"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; node (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/lifecycle.mjs') codex PreToolUse"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; node (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/lifecycle.mjs') codex PostToolUse"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; node (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/lifecycle.mjs') codex PostToolUse maintenance"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; node (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/lifecycle.mjs') codex Stop"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; node (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/lifecycle.mjs') codex UserPromptSubmit"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; node (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/lifecycle.mjs') codex PreCompact"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; node (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/lifecycle.mjs') codex SubagentStart"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; node (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/lifecycle.mjs') codex SubagentStop"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; node (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/lifecycle.mjs') codex SessionEnd"
